intro: Welcome to Shen'dar Village introduces travelers to a remote haven shaped by ancient Highborne bloodlines and simmering factional rivalries. While the High Order and the Windshapers maintain an outward truce within the settlement, bitter tensions linger just beyond the village borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me.
Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Checked in with Rathiril then? Great. Lots of tension between the High Order and the Windshapers these days, but they keep things civil here in Shen'dar. Well, at least in the village anyway. What happens out in the wilds stays in the wilds.
Now that that's done, you look like someone who might be looking for something to do with their hands. I've got a few things that need doing, if you are game for a bit of work?
